purpose: Evaluate field data capture, provenance, offline resilience and synchronization aboard a real moving passenger vessel.
scope_statement: This pilot evaluates field data capture, provenance, offline resilience and synchronization aboard a real moving vessel. It does not constitute Antarctic field validation or an assessment of environmental impact.
operational_principle: The vessel does not adapt to the research; the research adapts to the vessel.
disclaimer: Independent OLEA methodological pilot. Presence in OLEA does not imply sponsorship, endorsement, environmental assessment, pollution detection, or validated science.
